title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 4: After the Blast

scenes.say: Same road. Same heat. Different day.
scenes.visual: a dusty desert road with a convoy in the distance under harsh sun, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali switches seats with Roddy. Small thing. Nobody thinks twice.
scenes.visual: two soldiers trading places at the doors of an armored vehicle, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a blinding white flash filling the frame, dust exploding outward, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ringing. Smoke. Somebody screaming his name.
scenes.visual: thick black smoke rising from a damaged vehicle, blurred figures running, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He crawls to Roddy. Holds his hand. Tells him stay with me.
scenes.visual: a soldier's hand gripping another's in the dust, smoke above, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
an empty helmet lying in the sand, smoke drifting past, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Back home, a flag is folded into thirteen perfect triangles.
scenes.visual: an honor guard folding an American flag at a cemetery, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali stands at the grave in dress blues and can't feel his legs.
scenes.visual: a soldier standing alone at a fresh grave, overcast sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: That should have been me, he whispers. That was my seat.
scenes.visual: a hand touching a white headstone, rain beginning, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Survivors carry two things. The weight, and the reason.
scenes.visual: a pair of dog tags held in a closed fist, dramatic side light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Five. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a single rose on a white headstone at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 4 of 25: After the Blast. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
